shared_input_contract.button_neutral: No pressed buttons; trigger axes may rest at nonzero
shared_input_contract.origin_validation: Both input preflight and floor callback accept only MessageInfo publisher GID matching the exact single endpoint. Endpoint GID is pinned after discovery; initial unqualified samples never establish readiness and later unexpected sources abort.
shared_input_contract.native_parameter_validation_pending: Installed executable and actual parameter names/types, including coalesce_interval, are not inferred; native preflight requires exact response and fails before homing on mismatch.

input_only_modes.default: Describe-only; no ROS imports/init, Popen or devices
input_only_modes.graph_device: Explicit --run-input-only discovers/consumes exact real Joy; no synthetic Joy, controller manager, hardware plugins, launch or motion calls. Exit0 means graph/device diagnostic only, not physical button verification.
input_only_modes.button_exercise: Separately requires --exercise-buttons --no-motor-stack-confirmed after root current host-wide no-motor-stack confirmation. Prompts Options/R3 only after exact graph/params/fresh qualified input and known-process screen.
input_only_modes.cross_domain_limit: ROS isolation does not isolate the physical gamepad. Stdlib /proc known-process screen has limited scope; inspection failures block button exercise. No independent motor-power-disconnect capability is assumed.
input_only_modes.cleanup: Only owned input-only Joy child: bounded SIGINT, then SIGTERM and SIGKILL if necessary, reaped and recorded; any escalation/survivor is non-nominal. No motor-manager escalation added.

help.scope: No ROS initialization, input child, device or network operation

describe_only.scope: No ROS initialization, input child, device or network operation

result.scope: Input-only; default description does not initialize ROS or start processes
result.subscriber_qos: RELIABLE VOLATILE depth10, identical to the floor consumer
result.optional_physical_sequence: Release buttons, press/release Options(index9), press/release R3(index12), release buttons; trigger/stick centering is not required
result.external_domain_limit: ROS domain isolation does not isolate the physical gamepad from another running motor stack. Button exercise requires current root confirmation plus a read-only known-process check.

source_inventory_only.scope: No ROS initialization, input child, device or network operation

motion_release.integration_boundary: Enabling one boolean is insufficient. Restore reviewed installed-environment/library/config/source pins and runtime verification; resolve failed native evidence/fallback; pass exact current input-only preflight. Current supervisor intentionally runs graph-only preflight but requires full passed=true, so cannot continue to homing until the operator/root button precondition is explicitly integrated and reviewed. Existing hardware gains, joint limits, stock policy, time bounds and manager-only SIGINT teardown are not widened.
motion_release.remaining_process_limit: Frozen floor Joy cleanup is probe-owned; abrupt probe death can leave its Joy child while independent manager deadline runs. Verify no Joy survivor before future launch. No new rendezvous framework introduced.
